text:
Ana (PM): Kicking off Q1 hosted API slice grooming — need to finalize scope for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank by EOD Friday.
Mike (Eng): quick ask — infra dependency on batching improvements. without that p95 for chat jumps. estimate 2 sprints.
Devon (ML): embeddings perf note: customers want 4x cheaper vector ops; we can push a quantized path but recall/quality tradeoffs.
Sarah (Product Ops): we should list launch criteria per slice: SLOs, regression tests, docs, SDK samples, pricing decisions.
Ana (PM): proposed minimal launch criteria: 1) p95 latency targets per model class, 2) embedding cost/unit <= target, 3) rerank accuracy >= baseline on 3 eval sets, 4) canary + rollback plan.
Jordan (SRE): for p95 targets we need canary hooks and alerting. suggest this SLO table:
```
chat-small: p95 < 150ms
chat-large: p95 < 350ms
embeddings: p95 < 200ms
```
Mike (Eng): that table seems aggressive w/o batching. If we scope chat-small first we can hit targets earlier.
Lina (Design): SDK surface note — want a single `createChat` API that supports streaming + metadata. sample call in docs should be ready at launch.
Kevin (Sales): FYI: two pilot customers (AcmeSearch, NoteWave) require embeddings SLA and deterministic ranking. they'd like launch in 8 weeks.
Devon (ML): rerank tradeoff: using cross-encoder improves relevance but increases latency x3. Option: hybrid - embed-based first pass + micro cross-encoder on top-k. Needs infra support.
Ana (PM): decision needed: accept hybrid rerank (adds infra + cost) or keep linear rerank with better scoring. We need customer prioritization.
Kevin (Sales): AcmeSearch will pay for hybrid if we can guarantee p99 < 1s on top-k path. NoteWave prefers lower cost even if relevance slightly lower.
Sarah (Product Ops): Proposal: split into two launch slices: Slice A (chat-small + embeddings basic + linear rerank) for GA, Slice B (hybrid rerank + embeddings quantized + SDK polish) as post-GA in 8-12 weeks.
Mike (Eng): +1 for split. That lets infra focus batching + caching for Slice A and reserve heavy changes for B.
Jordan (SRE): for Slice A we need canary config; suggest rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with safety rollback on error rate or p95 regressions. I'll draft the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary job queued for hosted-api/slice-A at 2026-04-06T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Ana (PM): next actions: Mike to surface sprint plan and blocker list by EOD Wed, Devon to finalize eval sets and baseline numbers, Sarah to write launch checklist, Kevin to confirm paying pilot timelines.
Mike (Eng): compiling blockers now — primary: batching infra (2 sprints), SDK streaming fixes (1 sprint), canary pipeline tweaks (1 sprint).
Devon (ML): eval sets: search-rerank-dev, support-summarization, qa-embeddings — will post metrics in the thread tomorrow.
Lina (Design): I'll mock up docs flow and example requests today; need sample payloads from Mike.
Ana (PM): thanks — let's regroup Thu 10am to lock scope. If anyone can't make it, post blockers here. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Sales): noted. I'll push AcmeSearch timeline to align with Slice B if hybrid delayed.
Sarah (Product Ops): created a tracker card: https://redwood.atlassian.example/PROJECT-123 (links ok for reference)
Ana (PM): end-of-thread summary: Slice A = GA (chat-small, basic embeddings, linear rerank, SDK 1.0, canary). Slice B = post-GA (hybrid rerank, quantized embeddings, SDK polish). Goals: reduce launch risk and meet paying customer needs. We'll use that framing for OKR sub-items.
